gloss: to keep saying; to continue to say

definitions.gloss: to keep saying; to continue saying without stopping
definitions.explanation: To persist in saying something — repeatedly or over a sustained period. Compound of {言|い}う (to say) + {続|つづ}ける (to continue). Emphasizes persistence or repetition of speech.

examples.japanese: ずっと{同|おな}じことを{言|い}い{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: He keeps saying the same thing over and over.

examples.japanese: 「{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}」と{言|い}い{続|つづ}けることで、{自分|じぶん}を{励|はげ}ました。
examples.english: By continuing to say 'It'll be okay,' she encouraged herself.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}にも{信|しん}じてもらえなかったが、{彼|かれ}は{真実|しんじつ}を{言|い}い{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: Even though no one believed him, he kept saying the truth.

notes:
Compound verb: {言|い}う (godan) + {続|つづ}ける (ichidan). The combination is ichidan. The ～続ける suffix attaches to the verb stem and means 'to continue doing'. Can express both repeated statements over time and a sustained stream of speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同|おな}じことを{言|い}い{続|つづ}ける: to keep saying the same thing
- {言|い}い{続|つづ}けてきた: has been saying (for a long time)
- {主張|しゅちょう}し{続|つづ}ける: to keep insisting (related pattern)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {言|い}い{張|は}る: to insist, to maintain — implies stubborn insistence
- {繰|く}り{返|かえ}し{言|い}う: to repeat, to say again and again — emphasizes repetition
